all.source_quote: Must be 40 years or below at the time of application
Must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution (India or abroad)

unmodelled.text: Must have lived in West Bengal for ten years or more
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be a resident of West Bengal for ten years or more

unmodelled.text: Must have completed at least Class IX (Madhyamik or equivalent)
unmodelled.source_quote: Should have completed at least Class IX (Madhyamik or equivalent)

unmodelled.text: Must have admission in an eligible course (school, UG, PG or professional)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must have secured admission in an eligible course (school, UG, PG, or professional)

unmodelled.text: Needs a co-borrower, usually a parent or guardian
Neither the student nor the co-borrower may be in default on a bank loan
unmodelled.source_quote: Applicant or Co-borrower must not be in default of any bank loan
Only one student credit card per student is allowed

unmodelled.text: Must apply on the official portal with valid documents
unmodelled.source_quote: Must apply through the official online portal with valid documents

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines
'Class IX (Madhyamik or equivalent)' is unclear, because Madhyamik is the Class 10 exam, so the class is not modelled

en.title: West Bengal Student Credit Card
en.benefit: Collateral-free education loan up to Rs 10 lakh at about 4% simple interest, repayable over up to 15 years.
en.how_to_apply: Register on the WBSCC portal, apply with admission and ID documents; the institution and Higher Education Department verify it before the bank sanctions.
